improvements: Added the full r16476195 aggregate connectors around the five mapped terminal parts.
Preserved the verified inner courtyard w1215078738.
Replaced guessed control-cabin and 20 m pier-spine outlines with the exact source polygons; cabin spans 20–25 m.

Separated independently measured departures white hall roofs, dark membrane zones, Vioara membranes and seven roof strips, clipped to complete mapped source rings. All seven colliders, source IDs, heights and courtyard geometry remain unchanged.
Replaced the flat arrivals cap with ten independently measured repeated curved bays, clipped to the exact source ring; total14m and existing collision bands stay unchanged.

Pier assembly uses 32 literal source-part footprints and height ranges once, including open space below mapped elevated connectors; narrow untagged residual strips inherit an explicit estimated adjacent height band.
remainingGaps: Connector roof height 12 m is explicitly estimated; the aggregate has max_level=2 but no height.
Departures and arrivals heights remain estimates. Pier parts use literal mapped heights; 120 small residual outline cells use estimated adjacent part bands.
Static aircraft and some jet-bridge details are legacy illustrations, not surveyed current aircraft positions.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.
Roof plant/HVAC equipment and membrane/weathering detail are incomplete. Pixel RGB observations have unknown imagery acquisition lighting and are material-colour estimates.

Arrivals bay count10, axis84.47degrees and median spacing8.88m are independently measured; rise1.2m is estimated within the prior total14m. A northern imagery/source outline mismatch of approximately5–6m is retained as uncertainty; the source boundary is preserved.

checks.label: Historical source boundary and replacement-identity checks
checks.details: Historical source-boundary evidence: tools/landmarks/bucharest-source-check.mjs: 3 authored source rings; explicit replacement IDs match the source ledger. The earlier run across 33 models recorded 306 checks. The later accepted source-book update b203c38abf3651dd3d472c491238ad36089a633a records 456 checks across 33 models, including this entry, in handoffs/fidelity/remaining-ro-districts/cec-source-masses/shared-source-ledger-proof.json. This wording update cites that existing proof; no tests were rerun and no images were recaptured.

checks.label: Finite geometry and collision regression
checks.details: tools/landmarks/geometry-check.mjs: all 61 models pass finite geometry, normals and triangle accounting; dedicated concave courtyard, roof and height-band checks pass.

checks.label: Mandatory foot / driving regression
checks.details: Immutable production ef21d14: npm run harness -- --scenario=foot,a --city=bucharest completed 0 high / 0 medium / 1 low (software-GL FPS only). Both scenario screenshots inspected.

checks.label: Published game studies inspected
checks.details: Front, top and oblique game-only studies inspected against source outlines and available independent reference photographs. Remaining shape discrepancies are listed explicitly.

checks.label: Matched exterior Street View comparison
checks.details: Requested outdoor panorama did not reliably provide a matched visible exterior (wrong nearby view, indoor imagery, occlusion or unavailable coverage); this is not treated as an exterior pass.

checks.label: Complete district / traffic / mirror budget
checks.details: These are isolated model studies. Paired Romana samples had unchanged findings and world-only peak1.13M triangles/296 calls, with an Arnia capture timeout; traffic and mirror budget and all tourist-scene placements require the district lanes.

checks.label: Independent roof-zone area and collision checks
checks.details: roof-zones-check.mjs verifies complete nonoverlapping source roof areas and byte-identical seven colliders against d35d3d5. Colour zones derive only from independent Esri pixels; no source imagery is published.

checks.label: Arrivals roof/source model regression
checks.details: All61-model finite geometry/normal/triangle-accounting checks and all33 Bucharest source checks pass after the roof profile change. Seven source/courtyard colliders remain byte-identical to d35d3d5. Three fresh59f953f game-only studies were inspected; oblique camera distance1000m retains the complete terminal.

checks.label: Pier part union and elevated clearance
checks.details: 32 source footprints and height ranges exactly retained, 152 collider bands, original/alternate native views, physical under-bridge and solid-volume controls. Mandatory foot/a 0 high / 0 medium. District sweep has unchanged inherited findings. See fix-otp-terminal/summary.json.
